name: The Woman in the Basement
source:
When you're tasked to clean up your recently deceased grandfather's house, you find something, er, someone in the basement.

[From [url=https://garbledmess.itch.io/the-woman-in-the-basement]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受託清理祖父過世後留下的房子，卻在地下室發現了某樣東西——呃，某個人。

[來源：[url=https://garbledmess.itch.io/the-woman-in-the-basement]Itch.io[/url]]
